TableCalendar.doc: Highly customizable, feature-packed Flutter calendar with gestures, animations and multiple formats.

focusedDay.doc: DateTime that determines which days are currently visible and focused.

firstDay.doc:
The first active day of `TableCalendar`.
Blocks swiping to days before it.

lastDay.doc:
The last active day of `TableCalendar`.
Blocks swiping to days after it.

currentDay.doc: DateTime that will be treated as today. Defaults to `DateTime.now()`.

locale.doc: Locale to format `TableCalendar` dates with, for example: `'en_US'`.

rangeStartDay.doc: The start of the selected day range.

rangeEndDay.doc: The end of the selected day range.

weekendDays.doc:
List of days treated as weekend days.
Use built-in `DateTime` weekday constants (e.g. `DateTime.monday`) instead of `int` literals (e.g. `1`).

headerVisible.doc: Determines the visibility of calendar header.

daysOfWeekVisible.doc: Determines the visibility of the row of days of the week.

pageJumpingEnabled.doc:
When set to true, tapping on an outside day in `CalendarFormat.month` format
will jump to the calendar page of the tapped month.

pageAnimationEnabled.doc:
When set to true, updating the `focusedDay` will display a scrolling animation
if the currently visible calendar page is changed.

sixWeekMonthsEnforced.doc:
When set to true, `CalendarFormat.month` will always display six weeks,
even if the content would fit in less.

shouldFillViewport.doc: When set to true, `TableCalendar` will fill available height.

weekNumbersVisible.doc: Whether to display week numbers on calendar.

rowHeight.doc: Used for setting the height of `TableCalendar`'s rows.

daysOfWeekHeight.doc: Used for setting the height of `TableCalendar`'s days of week row.

formatAnimationDuration.doc: Specifies the duration of size animation that takes place whenever `calendarFormat` is changed.

formatAnimationCurve.doc: Specifies the curve of size animation that takes place whenever `calendarFormat` is changed.

pageAnimationDuration.doc: Specifies the duration of scrolling animation that takes place whenever the visible calendar page is changed.

pageAnimationCurve.doc: Specifies the curve of scrolling animation that takes place whenever the visible calendar page is changed.

startingDayOfWeek.doc: `TableCalendar` will start weeks with provided day.

availableGestures.doc:
Specifies swipe gestures available to `TableCalendar`.
If `AvailableGestures.none` is used, the calendar will only be interactive via buttons.

daysOfWeekStyle.doc: Style for days of week displayed between `TableCalendar`'s header and content.

calendarBuilders.doc:
Set of custom builders for `TableCalendar` to work with.
Use those to fully tailor the UI.

loadEventsForDisabledDays.doc:
Allows to load events for days that are not enabled
If `true` it will ignore `enabledDayPredicate` when calling `eventLoader`.
If `false` then `enabledDayPredicate` will be used to check when to call `eventLoader`

onRangeSelected.doc: Called whenever a day range gets selected.

onDaySelected.doc: Called whenever any day gets tapped.

onDayLongPressed.doc: Called whenever any day gets long pressed.

onDisabledDayTapped.doc: Called whenever any disabled day gets tapped.

onDisabledDayLongPressed.doc: Called whenever any disabled day gets long pressed.

onHeaderLongPressed.doc: Called whenever header gets long pressed.

onPageChanged.doc: Called whenever currently visible calendar page is changed.

BorderStyle.doc: The style of line to draw for a [BorderSide] in a [Border].

BoxFit.doc: How a box should be inscribed into another box.

BoxShape.doc: The shape to use when rendering a [Border] or [BoxDecoration].

CalendarFormat.doc: Formats that the calendar can display.

ColorSpace.doc: The color space describes the colors that are available to an [Image].

FilterQuality.doc:
Quality levels for image sampling in [ImageFilter] and [Shader] objects that sample
images and for [Canvas] operations that render images.

FlutterLogoStyle.doc: Possible ways to draw Flutter's logo.

FontStyle.doc: Whether to use the italic type variation of glyphs in the font.

HitTestBehavior.doc: How to behave during hit tests.

ImageRepeat.doc: How to paint any portions of a box not covered by an image.

RangeSelectionMode.doc: Modes that range selection can operate in.

StartingDayOfWeek.doc: Days of the week that the calendar can start with.

TextBaseline.doc: A horizontal line used for aligning text.

TextDecorationStyle.doc: The style in which to draw a text decoration

TextOverflow.doc: How overflowing text should be handled.

TileMode.doc: Defines how to handle areas outside the defined bounds of a gradient or image filter.

WebHtmlElementStrategy.doc:
The strategy for [Image.network] and [NetworkImage] to decide whether to
display images in HTML elements contained in a platform view instead of
fetching bytes.

AlignmentGeometry.doc:
Base class for [Alignment] that allows for text-direction aware
resolution.

AssetBundle.doc: A collection of resources used by the application.

BorderRadius.doc: An immutable set of radii for each corner of a rectangle.

BorderSide.doc: A side of a border of a box.

Color.doc: An immutable color value in ARGB format.

ColorFilter.doc:
A description of a color filter to apply when drawing a shape or compositing
a layer with a particular [Paint]. A color filter is a function that takes
two colors, and outputs one color. When applied during compositing, it is
independently applied to each pixel of the layer being drawn before the
entire layer is merged with the destination.

Curve.doc:
An parametric animation easing curve, i.e. a mapping of the unit interval to
the unit interval.

DateTime.doc: An instant in time, such as July 20, 1969, 8:18pm GMT.

DaysOfWeekStyle.doc: Class containing styling for `TableCalendar`'s days of week panel.

Decoration.doc: A description of a box decoration (a decoration applied to a [Rect]).

DecorationImage.doc: An image for a box decoration.

Duration.doc: A difference between points in time.

EdgeInsets.doc: An immutable set of offsets in each of the four cardinal directions.

EdgeInsetsGeometry.doc:
Base class for [EdgeInsets] that allows for text-direction aware

FontFeature.doc: A feature tag and value that affect the selection of glyphs in a font.

FontVariation.doc: An axis tag and value that can be used to customize variable fonts.

FontWeight.doc: The thickness of the glyphs used to draw the text.

GradientTransform.doc:
Base class for transforming gradient shaders without applying the same
transform to the entire canvas.

HeaderStyle.doc: Class containing styling and configuration of `TableCalendar`'s header.

ImageProviderOfObject.doc:
Identifies an image without committing to the precise final asset. This
allows a set of images to be identified and for the precise image to later
be resolved based on the environment, e.g. the device pixel ratio.

LinearBorderEdge.doc: Defines the relative size and alignment of one [LinearBorder] edge.

Locale.doc: An identifier used to select a user's language and formatting preferences.

Paint.doc: A description of the style to use when drawing on a [Canvas].

PositionedOffset.doc: Helper class containing data for internal `Positioned` widget.

Radius.doc: A radius for either circular or elliptical shapes.

Rect.doc:
An immutable, 2D, axis-aligned, floating-point rectangle whose coordinates
are relative to a given origin.

TextDecoration.doc: A linear decoration to draw near the text.

TextStyle.doc: An immutable style describing how to format and paint text.

Uri.doc: A parsed URI, such as a URL.

ViewPadding.doc:
A representation of distances for each of the four edges of a rectangle,
used to encode the view insets and padding that applications should place
around their user interface, as exposed by [FlutterView.viewInsets] and
[FlutterView.padding]. View insets and padding are preferably read via
[MediaQuery.of].
